### workspace sessions --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace sessions [options] [project]

Show the coding-agent sessions running in a workspace's panes,
whether each is working, idle, waiting on a person, or done, and any
sub-agents they started.

STATE column: working (output changing), idle (output unchanged 30s+),
waiting (the agent asked for permission or input; needs the
Notification hook from workspace init), or done (the agent's turn
ended; needs the Stop hook). A waiting pane shows the
agent's message on the line below it. waiting is Claude Code only;
other agents (Codex, OpenCode, Pi) only ever show working or idle.

Requires a running agent daemon (workspace agentd <project>; re-run
`workspace init` if `workspace doctor` reports it missing).

LOCK column: shows every lock a pane holds or waits on (e.g. "edit ✓ devenv #2",
space-joined, edit first and others alphabetical). JSON output includes a locks array.

--worktrees also shows sessions for the project's child worktree workspaces
(config names "<project>.worktree-*"), one table per workspace that has an
agent daemon running; workspaces without one are omitted silently. With no
[project], the parent of the current worktree is used, so the whole family
shows even when run from inside a worktree. --json nests them under a
"workspaces" array.

Options:
        --name WS                    The project, as an option (same as the positional [project])
        --json                       Emit the raw payload instead of a table
        --watch                      Redraw until interrupted
        --interval SECONDS           Seconds between redraws (default 2)
        --worktrees                  Also show sessions for child worktree workspaces

Examples:
  workspace sessions    # sessions for the current directory's project
  workspace sessions my-project    # sessions for a named project
  workspace sessions --watch    # watch and redraw every 2 seconds
  workspace sessions --json    # emit raw JSON for scripting
  workspace sessions my-project --worktrees    # include the project's worktree workspaces
--- stderr
--- end

### workspace sessions
--- exit 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
